answer: Thus, each alias costs 6 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the voyage record shows exactly who is still on probation. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the lantern queue naming the glacier that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 6 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
